name: ch51-transfer-chart
caption: Agreement by place.
live:
import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """place,agreement_with_WorldCover,kappa
"Bandung (home, new points)",0.848,0.81
"Garut, West Java (60 km)",0.728,0.66
"Lampung, Sumatra (400 km)",0.712,0.64
"Pontianak, Kalimantan (800 km)",0.678,0.5975
"Makassar, Sulawesi (1,300 km)",0.848,0.81
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_transfer(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.4, 3.4))
    ax.barh(df.place[::-1], df.agreement_with_WorldCover[::-1], color="#2a78d6")
    for y, v in enumerate(df.agreement_with_WorldCover[::-1]):
        ax.text(v, y, f" {v:.2f}", va="center", fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_xlabel("Agreement with WorldCover 2021 (500 test points per place)")
    ax.set_title("One saved model, five places", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    return fig

plot_transfer(df)
plt.show()
